rough_goal: Run a 7-day growth sprint for my iOS and Android habit-tracking subscription app, moving from 200 to 600 paying subscribers and from $4,000 to $12,000 MRR

answers.success_criteria: Success is moving active paying subscribers from 200 to at least 600 and MRR from $4,000 to at least $12,000 within exactly 7 days, verified in Stripe. Activation should rise from about 30% to at least 40% of new installs and paid trial starts from about 4% to at least 8% of activated users, verified in Mixpanel, while trial-to-paid conversion stays at or above 50%. At least one owner-approved ASO, lifecycle email, paid campaign, or pricing experiment must show a measurable before/after lift, and a daily summary plus Mixpanel dashboard evidence must be delivered every sprint day.
answers.subject_scope: The work is about the habit-tracking mobile app installs and users across iOS and Android, the Mixpanel funnel cohorts segmented by source and platform, the Stripe paying subscribers and MRR, lifecycle campaigns in Customer.io and Intercom, App Store and Play Store listings, and Meta and Google Ads paid campaigns targeting busy professionals.
answers.allowed_context: Hermes may read Mixpanel funnels and Stripe revenue, draft ASO copy for the App Store and Play Store, draft lifecycle emails in Customer.io, draft Intercom and in-app messages, and draft Meta and Google Ads campaigns and creatives. Read-only analysis is preferred. No personal channels or unapproved live sends are allowed.
answers.approval_boundaries: Owner approval is required before any mass Customer.io email, any direct user messaging through Intercom or in-app, any live Stripe pricing change, any discount, any App Store or Play Store publication, and any ad spend above $50/day. Ad spend must never exceed the $2,000/month hard cap, no discount may exceed 30%, no health claims are allowed in any copy, and under-18 users must never be targeted. Drafting and analysis are autonomous; external side effects are owner-approval-gated.
answers.workflow_path: First capture Stripe and Mixpanel baselines on day 0, then prioritize the top growth bets on day 1, next draft ASO, lifecycle, ad, and pricing assets into an approval queue, then launch only owner-approved experiments across days 2 to 5, after that double down on winners or cut losers on days 5 to 6, and finally run the approved day 7 push and compile the closeout proof packet. Stop when targets are reached, the sprint ends, approval is withheld, or a hard stop like the spend cap or discount cap would be breached.
answers.proof_requirements: Every sprint day needs a daily owner summary, a Mixpanel dashboard link or screenshot with before/after metrics, a Stripe revenue snapshot of subscribers and MRR, campaign logs with spend and CAC, lifecycle send logs, an experiment scorecard, an approval audit log, and a compliance checklist confirming no health claims, no under-18 targeting, discount at or below 30%, and ad spend within cap. No card is done from prose.
answers.stop_and_escalation_rules: Escalate to the owner before any ad spend above $50/day, when projected spend approaches the $2,000/month cap, before any mass email or direct message, before any live pricing or discount change, whenever copy might contain health claims or could target under-18s, when Mixpanel or Stripe proof is unavailable, and when subscriber or MRR pace is off by day 3 or day 5. Stop experiments that approach a hard stop or show materially negative conversion.
